I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

On 2025-09-03, Priyanka posted in that channel that label printing had stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots during the carrier API outage. She said totes were stacked beside door 4 at Southgate dispatch. Her update that evening said Southgate had cleared the backlog. The channel doesn't give a street address or any other details about the site, so I told him that too.

I only read #inc-tansley-carrier-api, which Tobias is a member of.
